name: Uz
overview: Uz was a male Edomite known primarily as the son of Dishan. His identity is grounded in his lineage within the Edomite tribe. Beyond this familial connection, Scripture does not provide additional details about his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Uz appears as a proper name in the biblical record, with no specific meaning or divine origin given. It is simply the personal name by which he is identified in Genesis 36:28.
familyAndRelationships: Uz is explicitly recorded as the son of Dishan, establishing his place within the Edomite genealogy. No further family relationships are noted in Scripture beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Uz's significance lies in his role as a descendant within the Edomite lineage, which is important for understanding the genealogical and tribal structures in the Bible. His mention in Genesis 36:28 situates him among the descendants of Esau, providing historical context for the Edomite people. While not a major biblical figure, his inclusion helps preserve the record of God's providential care over all nations through their genealogies.
